stops.stop: Hotel Majestic, the company's hotel on the Avenida de Mayo
stops.date_confidence: the wedding day, 10 September 1913, is attested (Buckle; Ostwald pp. 87-89). Nijinsky's presence at the Majestic in 1913 is reported by the Argentine press on the hotel's history (Pagina/12, 2007) and by the city's heritage pages, which say he married there; the church was San Miguel Arcangel (Forn, Pagina/12, 2013). That the wedding celebration was held in the hotel is a reader's claim that no reached source confirms, and the civil registry and the witnesses are not named
